name: Dr Neetu Grover
title: MBBS, FRACGP, Adv DRANZCOG, Skin Cancer
paras: Dr Neetu Grover MBBS, FRACGP, Adv DRANZCOG - Senior GP has been providing general medical services for the past 20 years. She lives in Wodonga with her family, raising 3 of her children in the local community and has a passion for Rural General Practice.

Dr Grover spent several years working in various hospitals in both Australia, UK & India to gain a broad experience base and also specialises in Obstetrics and Gynecology, Skin Cancer, Defense and DVA patients.
Dr Grover works full time and is happy to manage all types of medical consultations.
Dr Grover speaks various Languages including English, Hindi, Punjabi Urdu.
In her spare time, Dr Grover loves listening to music and cooking. She understands the various cultures and traditions of different countries.

name: Dr Ayesha
title: General Practitioner
paras: Dr. Ayesha has worked in both General Practice and the hospital setting and enjoys all aspects of General Practice.
Dr. Ayesha relocated from Sydney and lives with her husband. In her spare time, she enjoys travelling with her family & friends, Watching Sports and spending time outdoors.
Consulting Days: All weekdays and some Saturday
If you are struggling to get GP appointments elsewhere, why not say hello her while her books are still open.

name: Dr Joseph
title: General Practitioner
paras: Dr. Joseph has years of clinical experience, predominantly in primary care.
He has worked in hospitals and GP clinics and enjoys all aspects of General Practice.
Outside the clinic, Joseph spends his free time travelling, cooking, and enjoying various physical activities.
General Medicine | Occupational Medicine | Chronic Disease Management | Sports and Exercise Medicine | Mental Health

name: Dr Sinto Kunjachan
title: General Practitioner
paras: Dr Sinto has years of experience in General practice and in Hospital.

After completing her degree form Deakin University Melbourne, she along with her husband and two young children have settled in Wodonga. She has a keen interest in chronic Disease Management, Mental Health and General Health Promotion.
Her hobbies include reading Medical Journals and has been awarded “Jan Moore Award for her Excellence in Research" for her Project.
She works Full time and looks forward to long-term relationships with her patients.
In her leisure time, she enjoys travelling, exploring new places, cooking and having quality time with Family.

name: Dr Bhavin Purohit
title: General Practitioner
paras: Dr Bhavin (MD AASC DNB MRCGP) is qualified in India, United Kingdom and United States, and is a highly experienced family medicine doctor and specialist with over 15 years of experience.
Dr Bhavin's special interests include Allergies, diabetes, cardiology, hyper-tension, and asthma along with all aspects of men's and women's health.
Dr. Bhavin has also achieved additional advanced qualifications including DFID, FICM, AASC, FCC, PG Diab (Boston), CCEBDM, CCGDM, and Dip Card Endo (RCP)

name: Dr Lyza Cara
title: General Practitioner
paras: Dr Lyza Cara has been working in Wodonga since 2023 and is a warm and experienced General Practitioner who loves caring for people at every stage of life. She values building long-term relationships with her patients and enjoys being part of their health journey — whether it’s helping with day-to-day health concerns or supporting long-term wellness goals.
Dr Cara takes a special interest in mental health, children’s health, and chronic disease management.
Outside the clinic, she enjoys experimenting in the kitchen, exploring local parks and hiking trails, and planning her next travel adventure.

name: Dr Iby Ann Xavier
title: General Practitioner
paras: Dr. Iby is a highly experienced family medicine doctor and specialist with over 12 years of experience.
She is a dedicated general practitioner with a holistic approach to patient care, committed to supporting individuals and families across all stages of life.
She has a special interest in geriatric medicine, mental health, and chronic disease management.
She values building long-term relationships with her patients to help them achieve their best health outcomes.
Outside of work, she enjoys dancing and gardening, and is very much a family-oriented person who believes in balance and compassion both in and out of the clinic.

name: Dr Sonam Topgyal
title: General Practitioner
paras: Dr Sonam Topgyal is a Family Physician with over 15 years of clinical experience and a special interest in child health and emergency medicine.

He is a patient-oriented medical practitioner committed to providing safe, high-quality, and compassionate care. Dr Topgyal values building trusting relationships with his patients while maintaining complete confidentiality.
He has worked across a variety of healthcare settings in both the public and private sectors, bringing broad experience and dedication to quality patient care.

name: Dr Warren
title: General Practitioner
paras: Dr Warren is an experienced doctor with over 15 years of clinical experience. He provides comprehensive general practice care with a strong focus on patient-centred, family-focused medicine.

Dr Warren enjoys supporting patients across all stages of life and has a special interest in lifestyle coaching, preventative health, and chronic disease management. He takes the time to understand each patient’s individual needs and works with them to develop practical, sustainable approaches to their health and wellbeing.
His areas of interest include general medicine, chronic disease management, lifestyle coaching, preventative health, and family medicine.
Dr Warren is now accepting new patients at Elmwood Medical Centre.
Billing Type: Mixed Billed available with Dr Warren. Please see billing schedule here schedule for details.
Consulting Days: Open 7 days

name: Margi Patel
title: Registered Dietitian
paras: Bulk Billed Dietitian Services – All Ages Accepted

Margi Patel is a passionate and experienced Dietitian providing tailored, evidence-based nutrition care to a wide range of populations. She works collaboratively with individuals to promote nutrition adequacy, independence, and long-term health outcomes. Her approach is person-centred, evidence-based, and non-judgmental, empowering clients to achieve their individual nutrition goals with confidence.

Margi has a genuine passion for food and enjoys supporting clients to make nourishing, practical food choices that suit their lifestyle. She is skilled in working with clients with intellectual and learning disabilities and is fluent in both English and Hindi.
In her spare time, Margi enjoys preparing vegetarian dishes for friends and family, travelling, and reading.
